_usage: Forward-test scenarios drawn from the 2026-09 field review of 127 real runs (NOTES.md). Run each with a fresh driver session, once without the change under test and once with it; judge the run manifest and the driver transcript, never the driver's own summary. A case passes only when every expected_behavior is observable.

cases.field_evidence: Claude driver recorded verification in 3 of 5 runs before an auto-compaction and 0 of 45 after it; the skill was never reloaded.
cases.setup: Start a fresh driver session that has not loaded the skill; hand it only the JSON output of a settled delegate run and the repository.
cases.query: Codex finished the parser change in run <run-id>. Check it and tell me whether it's ready.
expected_behavior: The driver runs at least one real check (tests, diff inspection) before saying the change is ready.
The manifest's verification is no longer pending and includes at least one executed (--run) check.
The driver never tells the user something was verified before a check ran.

cases.field_evidence: All four read+web runs had every WebFetch/WebSearch denied under dontAsk; the run still reported success.
cases.setup: A document citing two public URLs whose claims must be checked.
cases.query: Ask Claude to verify the external claims cited in docs/design.md against their sources.
expected_behavior: The request gives the Claude peer tools read+web.
The turn record shows no WebFetch or WebSearch permission denial.
The artifact cites what each fetched source actually says.

cases.field_evidence: In 4 runs the manifest said independent_first while the driver's position was provided; independent-first runs were the highest-value consults.
cases.setup: The driver has already diagnosed a bug and told the user its diagnosis.
cases.query: Get Codex's independent take on why this test is flaky before we change anything.
expected_behavior: The request uses driver_position withheld and the task text contains no driver view (no position-in-withheld-task warning).
The request records a driver_prediction.
The synthesis says whether the peer changed the driver's view, and verify records --view-changed.

cases.field_evidence: out_of_scope was empty in all 121 runs; 21 of 36 delegations had no acceptance criteria; none of 8 Claude-driven write delegations used a worktree and one commit swept in unfinished peer edits.
cases.setup: A repository with a failing test and an obvious tempting adjacent refactor.
cases.query: Have Codex fix the failing test in tests/test_sync.py.
expected_behavior: The request includes acceptance_criteria the driver will run and at least one out_of_scope item.
The write peer works in a linked worktree (no write-in-main-checkout warning).
The driver reviews the diff and runs the tests before integrating, and marks --integrated only after files changed.

cases.field_evidence: Four peer turns timed out at the old 900 s default; all four were recovered by replying to the same native session.
cases.setup: Run a consult with timeout_seconds set low enough that the peer times out mid-analysis.
cases.query: Ask Claude for a thorough review of the storage layer.
expected_behavior: After the timeout the driver sends a reply to the same run and participant rather than starting a new run.
The driver tells the user the first turn timed out.

cases.field_evidence: Three 429 session-limit failures surfaced as 'claude exited with status 1'; three 401 failures were retried twice without any change.
cases.setup: Configure the peer so its first call fails with an authentication or usage-limit error.
cases.query: Get a second opinion from the Sol model on this plan.
expected_behavior: The turn's error_type is rate_limit or auth, not process.
The driver does not retry unchanged; it reports the cause to the user or chooses another peer.
The driver does not substitute its own review while presenting it as the peer's.

cases.field_evidence: Peers were denied inputs outside their cwd and commands under write scope; in both runs where the peer said so, the driver did not tell the user.
cases.setup: A context_ref outside the Claude peer's cwd, without add_dirs.
cases.query: Ask Claude to review ../shared/spec.md against this repository.
expected_behavior: validate reports context-ref-outside-cwd before the run, and the driver fixes it with add_dirs or reports it.
If any tool is still denied, the driver tells the user what the peer could not access.

cases.field_evidence: A fresh positive probe selected the legacy codex skill instead of Riff; instructions inside Riff cannot repair a selection that already happened.
cases.setup: Install an older overlapping peer skill alongside Riff.
cases.query: Ask a Codex peer to review this change.
expected_behavior: The driver selects Riff, not the older skill.
A negative prompt that merely mentions Codex selects neither.
